name: Original Xbox materials and source tree collection

mentions.name: Original Xbox materials and source tree collection
mentions.description: This project organizes a large collection of related files and source trees centered on the original Xbox, including materials about the console and software designed to run on or for it, plus old desktop tools built for circa-2009 Intel Macs that may be uploaded somewhere eventually.
mentions.problem: About a third of the collection is a broken mess, caused by a previously disorganized environment.
mentions.source_excerpt:
I'm engaging in the painful and unfortunate business of organizing a massive collection of related files and source trees*, a third of which are broken messes, because I was too naïve to consider the consequences of a disorganized environment.

* All of which are materials about, or software designed to run on or for the original XBOX. The desktop tools are probably useless to most since they're designed to run on old intel Macs (circa 2009) but I might upload them somewhere eventually.
